cssSnippetFolder.description: Vault-relative folder, with forward slashes, whose .css files the Document carries as the vault's CSS snippets (architecture.md, CSS snippets).

longParagraphs.description: The long-paragraph lint, which warns about a paragraph whose estimated line count exceeds warningLines (input-model, Long paragraphs); each default applies where the core configuration names none.

warningLines.description: Estimated prose lines above which the lint warns.

lineCharacters.description: Characters per line of the estimate.

labels.description: The words before a number that make prose a typed figure number, which the figure lint warns about (input-model, Figure captions and references); the default applies to a build without core configuration.

commandTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds one cmd fence may run; the default applies to a build without core configuration.
